description: Lines that serve an ÖBB station according to the plan but that stage 2 has never seen there, at a station where other trains do run. Only needed for closures that began before stage 2 first looked (September 2026): stage 2 remembers a line it has seen for three years, and stage 3 does not judge train lines at a station where no train was ever seen. Used only by the report-only line check (stage 3, scripts/check_feed_lines.py). An entry applies up to and including 'until'; null means the end is open. An expired entry is logged for review only while HAFAS still does not show its lines.
